Name: Lootboxes for Stardew Valley
Author: MortaliB
Description:
[b]Finally updated to 1.0[/b]
[b]We plan on adding more Lootboxes and even new machines over time, so make sure to Track the mod[/b]

[b]What's new on 1.0?[/b]
- Huge visual overhaul
- New Lootbox:
﻿Artifact Lootbox: [i]A lootbox filled with every artifact that can be donated to the museum.
[/i]


Pierre will be selling Lootboxes along with a Lootbox Opener.

The Lootbox Opener takes 3 hours to open almost any lootbox.

The chances of the lootboxes can be found in the readme.txt included in the mod file.

Screenrant wrote an article about my mod, that's pretty cool! You can check it out: [url=https://screenrant.com/stardew-valley-mod-loot-boxes-pierre/amp/]https://screenrant.com/stardew-valley-mod-loot-boxes-pierre/amp/[/url]
